method: Natural Earth 10m IHO-derived marine polygons rasterized at 100 m EPSG:3410 over the CMSA+10 km domain; positive pixels outside every polygon assigned to the nearest group measured against group boundary pixels (KD-tree, exact to 1 pixel)

boundary_source.dataset: Natural Earth 1:10m Physical Vectors, Geography Marine Polygons
boundary_source.license: public domain (Natural Earth terms of use)
boundary_source.note: IHO-derived named sea areas; names verified against name_zh

grouping_conventions.Taiwan Strait: grouped with East China Sea (conventional); per-polygon CSV allows regrouping
grouping_conventions.Yellow Sea contains Bo Hai: Bo Hai is a separate NE polygon but included with the Yellow Sea group

explored_but_not_primary.approach: Natural Earth 10m admin-1 province groups + nearest-province
explored_but_not_primary.result: 86.0% of positive union pixels fall outside the admin-1 land polygons (coarse coastline excludes intertidal flats), so province groups cannot be used as the primary regional definition
